value.name: Disconnected components lie in a common rational pencil

research.author: packet 2026-09-14: LLM-derived, no claim-specific human check, no Lean kernel build
research.reason: high-priority human audit; re-audited against Assi's actual statements

semantics: KellerGroupoids.ProjectStatements.disjoint_of_not_sameComponent: core; audit verified; components in different connected components of S_F are disjoint, meeting generating the connected components
KellerGroupoids.ProjectStatements.exists_not_sameComponent_of_not_connected: core; audit verified; a disconnected S_F has two components in different connected components

KellerGroupoids.ProjectStatements.disconnectedNonproper_commonPencil: full; audit unapproved; a disconnected S_F lies in one rational one-place pencil with every connected component irreducible; from Jelonek's parametrisation and Assi's trichotomy as Published axioms, with connected components defined as the classes generated by meeting and the record's coherence field disjoint_of_pencilOf_eq (distinct members of one pencil are disjoint); verified once those two inputs are admitted
value.statement: If S_F is disconnected then every irreducible component is a fiber V(h − a_i) of one polynomial h with a rational one-place pencil, and every connected component of S_F is irreducible.

research.author: packet 2026-09-14: LLM-derived, no claim-specific human check, no Lean kernel build

semantics: KellerGroupoids.ProjectStatements.two_le_selectedFibers_of_not_connected: core; audit verified; a disconnected S_F selects at least two fibers

KellerGroupoids.ProjectStatements.commonPencil_exactlyTwoFibers: full; audit unapproved; exactly two selected fibers and a noncoordinate pencil, in the disconnected common-pencil case of a counterexample; from Assi's dichotomy and Braun–Dias–Venato-Santos as Published axioms, with the count of selected fibers defined as the number of components; verified once those two inputs are admitted
value.statement: In the situation of KG-EM08 the number q of selected fibers is 2: q ≥ 3 forces h equivalent to a coordinate by Assi's rational-pencil theorem, and a finite union of coordinate fibers misses another coordinate fiber, against the Braun–Dias–Venato-Santos intersection theorem.

value.name: Two-nodal-fiber theorem

research.author: packet 2026-09-14: LLM-derived, no claim-specific human check, no Lean kernel build
research.reason: highest-priority human audit; never to be described as Assi's theorem

semantics: KellerGroupoids.ProjectStatements.nonmaximal_implies_exactlyTwoNodalFibers: statement; audit unapproved; derived from KG-EM07, KG-EM08, KG-EM09 and Assi's equinodal theorem exactly as the audit derives it; open through the KG-EM07 hole
value.statement: If a plane Keller map is not étale-maximal then S_F = C_0 ⊔ C_1 with C_i = V(h − a_i) the two exceptional rational members of a noncoordinate one-place pencil; each C_i is rational with one place at infinity, and both have the same positive number of affine singular points, all ordinary transverse nodes. The classification of the two fibers is Assi's; the reduction from Keller non-maximality to it is the project's.
